gigs.description:
We are seeking a licensed CPA or senior bookkeeper to perform a comprehensive financial audit and chart-of-accounts cleanup for our operating entities in QuickBooks Online.

Key Deliverables:
1. Chart of Accounts audit, expense re-classification, and cleanup.
2. Multi-entity bank and Stripe merchant feeds reconciliation.
3. Preparation of GAAP-compliant balance sheets and P&L statements.
4. Organized tax depreciation schedules for annual filing.

2. Next.js 15 App Router interface with streaming token response & optimistic state caching.
3. Row Level Security (RLS) policies ensuring strict enterprise data tenant isolation.
4. Comprehensive Jest integration tests and GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment.
